disclaimer: This report summarises statistical diagnostics of observational data. It does not establish causal identifiability, clinical validity or safety of any model or policy. 'No concern detected' means only that the diagnostics found no evidence of a problem with the given data, model class and power.

validation_issues.message: No action column: MDP and offline-RL diagnostics are not assessable.

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: State completeness
criteria.interpretation: 0.0% of state values missing on decision rows.
criteria.next_step: Consider a POMDP/belief-state formulation or explicit missingness indicators; never impute silently.
assumptions: Counts missing cells on the decision rows provided; absent rows are not counted (see sampling intervals).

metrics.name: state_missingness
assumptions: Counts missing cells on the decision rows provided; absent rows are not counted (see sampling intervals).

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: Sampling regularity and fragmentation
criteria.interpretation: Interval CV = 1.44; 74.8% of trajectories contain gaps > 3x median interval.
criteria.next_step: Consider event-driven decision epochs (semi-MDP) or splitting trajectories at gaps.
assumptions: A gap is an interval longer than 3 x the median interval.

metrics.name: sampling_interval_cv
metrics.unit: CV of inter-decision intervals (0 = regular grid)
assumptions: A gap is an interval longer than 3 x the median interval.

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: Timestamp precision (heaping)
criteria.interpretation: 1.8% of timestamps on multiples of the largest unit; interpret against the dataset's native grid.
criteria.next_step: Do not choose a decision interval finer than the effective timestamp resolution.
assumptions: Heaping can also be a deliberate grid of the source dataset.
Time unit of the data must be known (e.g. minutes).

metrics.name: timestamp_heaping
metrics.unit: share of times on multiples of 60
assumptions: Time unit of the data must be known (e.g. minutes).
Heaping can also be a deliberate grid of the source dataset.

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: State freshness at decision times
criteria.interpretation: 90th percentile of observation age: 0 time units.
criteria.next_step: Compare observation age with the decision interval; stale states blur state-action ordering.
assumptions: Missing cells are treated as 'not measured at this time', not as data errors.

metrics.name: observation_age_p90
metrics.unit: time units since last observation (90th pct over variables/decisions)
assumptions: Missing cells are treated as 'not measured at this time', not as data errors.

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: Informative observation process
criteria.next_step: If informative, include measurement indicators/times in the state and treat missingness as MNAR in sensitivity analyses.
assumptions: Association only; informative measurement can reflect clinician suspicion (confounding by indication).

metrics.name: informative_missingness_outcome_auc
assumptions: Association only; informative measurement can reflect clinician suspicion (confounding by indication).
